description: This file contains JavaScript code that defines constants and functions for parsing and handling command-line arguments, specifically for test runner options and filters.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments, distinguishing between flags, their values, and positional arguments.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of explicit file filters specified in the command-line arguments by parsing them.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of file filter arguments explicitly provided in the command-line arguments.
